text: 国家发展改革委员会宏观经济研究院研究员刘琳表示，今年1-7月全国土地出让收入同比减少30.8%，对地方财政贡献继续大幅降低，这为推动房屋销售制度改革提供了时机窗口。商品房屋销售制度改革要求新供地项目和已购土地但未取得工程规划许可证项目，单体建筑完成主体结构封顶，才可预售，且鼓励优先选择现房销售方式。
text_en: Liu Lin, a researcher at the National Development and Reform Commission's Academy of Macroeconomic Research, said land sales revenue fell 30.8% year on year from January to July, sharply reducing its contribution to local finances, providing a window to advance housing sales system reform. The reform requires that for newly supplied land projects and existing land parcels without construction permits, presales are allowed only after the main structure of individual buildings is topped out, with spot sales encouraged as the preferred option.
